paite: Na va luah ding uh gamsung a TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pilut a, na ma ua nam tampi, Hitte, Girgaste, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste, nou sang a thupizaw leh hatzaw nam sagihte, adelhkhiak a;
heading: TOUPA Mite / (Eks 34.11-16)

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amaute nou ahon piak a, na thahgam chiang un amaute na hihgam sipsip ding ua; amaute toh thukhun na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
Zi leh ta in na nei ding uh ahi kei. Na tanute uh atapate uh na pe ding uh ahi kei. Atanute uh na tapate uh a ding na la ding uh ahi kei.
Na tapate uh, kei hon zuilaite pathian dangte biakna ah apikawi mai ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na tung uah aheh dia, hon hihmang pah ding hi.
Atung uah hichibang in na hih zaw ding uh ahi. Amaitam uh na hihchim ding ua, asuangphuhte uh na kitamzansak ding ua, a Asherahte uh na phuk ding ua, amilim bawltawmte uh na hal vek ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in lah nam siangthou na hi ngal ua. Leitung maikaih a nam tengteng tung a amah a tuam ding a TOUPA na Pathian un hon tel na hi uhi.
Namdang sang a na tam zawk ziak ua TOUPA'N na tung uah a-itna tusak a, hon tel ahi kei a, namdang tengteng a nam tawmpen na hi zomah uhi.

TOUPA'N noute ahon it ziak in leh na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna tangtun a-ut ziak in ahi zaw, TOUPA'N Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh khut a pan leh saltanna inn a pan khut hat mahmah a hon tatkhiak.
Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh Pathian ahi chih thei un. Pathian muanhuai, amah it a athu zuimi tung a suan sangkhat tan a athukhun leh behpihna zui gige,
amah hote hihmang dia amaitang mahmah ua thuk zel ahi. Amah hote ahal sawt kei dia, amaitang mahmah uah athuk ding hi.
Huaiziak in athupiakte, adante, dan thusehte, zui dia tuni a thu ka hon piak na zuih ding uh ahi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, avaihawmte na ngaihkhiak ua, na zuih ua, na hih ziak un TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna thukhun leh hehpihna na tung uah azui ding hi.
heading: Thumanna Vualzawlnate / (Diu 28.1-14)

paite: Noute ahon it dia, ahon vualzawl dia, hon hihpung ding hi. Piak ding a na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna gam ah na gil ua gah leh na leigah uh leng avualzawl lai ding. Na buhte uh, na uainte uh, na thaute uh; na bawngnou uh leh na belamnoute uh leng avualzawl ding hi.
Nam tengteng tung ah vualzawl na hi ding ua; na lak uah numei hiam pasal hiam, na gante uh lak ah leng ching himhim a-om kei ding hi.
TOUPA'N hipi tengteng hon hihthengsak vek dia, na theihsa uh Aigupta gam hipite na tung uah atungsak kei dia, nou hon hote tengteng tung ah atungsak zaw ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding nam tengteng na hihmang vek ding uhi. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, apathiante uh nna na sem ding uh ahi kei; huaite nou a dia thang ahih ding ziak in.
Na lungsim ua, "Hiai namte lah ei sang in atamzaw ngal ua, bangchi in i hawlkhe thei dia?" chi na hih uleh,
Amau kihta kei un. TOUPA na Pathian un Pharaoh leh Aigupta mi tengteng tung a athilhihte theigige un.

Ze-etna thupitak na mit mahmah ua na muhte uh, chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, khut hattakte leh ban zakte a TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon pikhiak; huchibang in TOUPA Pathian in na mi lauhte uh tung ah ahih ding hi.
Noumau a pan kibute leh akhosuaksunte amanthat vek tan un TOUPA na Pathian un alak uah tunpite asawl ding hi.
Amau na lau ding uh ahi kei. Pathian thupitak leh lauhuaitak TOUPA na Pathian uh na lak uah a-om hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un huai namte awlawl in ahon delhkhiaksak ding. Amau na hihmang pah ding uh ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw nou a ding in gamsate ahong tam lo kha ding uhi.
Ama'n masiah uh TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pe dia, buai petmah in ahihbuai ding hi.
Akumpipate uh na khut uah ahon pe dia, amin uh van nuai a pan na thaimang sipsip ding uh ahi. Na hihman sipsip tan un kuamah in hon dalzou kei ding hi.

Apathian lim bawltawmte uh na hal ding uh ahi. Huaite dangkasik hiam, dangka-eng hiam na enlah ding uh ahi kei. Nou a dia na lak ding uh ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na awk kha ding uh; TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia thilkihhuai ahi ngal ua.
Na insung ua thilkihhuai lalut in huai thil bang in hamsiat thuak ding in na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Kih petmah a kih in na mudah mahmah ding uh ahi, hamsiat thuakna thil lah ahi ngal ua.
